Privacy · Draft for review

Privacy notice

This draft explains how website enquiry information may be handled. Review it against actual business practices and applicable Kenyan law before publication.

Publication note: This is a starting draft, not legal advice. Confirm the responsible legal entity, lawful basis, retention period, processors, security procedures and data-subject rights process. Seek qualified Kenyan privacy review before launch.

Information you provide

If you send an enquiry, the website collects the information entered, which may include your name, organization, email, phone number, service interest, message, preferred contact method and privacy acknowledgement.

How information is used

Information may be used to review and respond to your enquiry, communicate about a potential engagement and maintain appropriate business records. Do not send passwords, payment details or unnecessary sensitive personal information through the form.

Service providers and transfers

The contact form is configured for Netlify Forms when deployed on Netlify. Confirm processing terms, storage locations, retention settings and cross-border transfers before publication. Update this section if other form, hosting, analytics or communications providers are introduced.

Retention and security

Information should be retained only for a defined business or legal purpose and protected with appropriate administrative and technical measures. The retention period and procedures need confirmation before publication.

Your choices and rights

Describe the rights and request process that apply under relevant privacy laws, including how to ask about, access, correct or request deletion of personal information. Publish a working privacy contact before launch.

Cookies and analytics

This initial implementation does not intentionally include analytics or advertising trackers. Review production hosting and future third-party tools; add required consent controls before enabling technologies that need them.

Contact
